# Autocomplete

Suggestions at the text caret: typing a trigger character, such as `@` for people or `:` for emoji, in a `TextArea` or `TextField` opens a list beside the caret, filtered by what follows the character. The arrow keys move through it, Enter or Tab inserts the suggestion in place of the trigger and its query, and Escape closes it. Focus stays in the text throughout: the text control points at the active suggestion with `aria-activedescendant`, and screen readers hear how many suggestions there are. The typed part of a suggestion's label shows in bold where it starts the label or one of its words. One control can have several triggers.

```tsx
import { Autocomplete } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/autocomplete/autocomplete";
```

## Example

```tsx
<Autocomplete
  triggers={[
    { char: "@", label: "People", allowSpaces: true, items: (query) => people.filter((p) => p.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 6) },
    { char: ":", label: "Emoji", minQueryLength: 2, items: (query) => emoji.filter((e) => e.value.startsWith(query)).slice(0, 8) },
  ]}
>
  <TextArea label="Message" hideLabel autoGrow rows={1} maxRows={8} value={text} onValueChange={setText} />
</Autocomplete>
```

## Usage

Insertion goes through the browser's own text editing, so Undo takes it back and the control's `onChange` and `onValueChange` run, controlled or not. `TextArea`'s `autoGrow` grows with it. In a `Composer`, the Enter that picks a suggestion does not send.

## Use instead when

- Use `Combobox` instead to choose one value for a field from a list, and `Command` for a command palette.

## Props

Type: `AutocompleteProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` (required) | `ReactElement` |  | The text control: one `TextArea`, `TextField`, `Composer`, `<textarea>` or `<input>`. Autocomplete gives it the list's ARIA, its keys while the list is open, and its ref. |
| `resultsLabel` | `((count: number, trigger: AutocompleteTrigger) => string)` | (count) => "1 suggestion" or "{count} suggestions" | What screen readers hear when the list opens or its length changes. |
| `triggers` (required) | `readonly AutocompleteTrigger[]` |  | The characters that open suggestions, such as `@` for people and `:` for emoji, with their lists. |

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `onSelect`: Not a prop. A trigger takes `onPick`: `{ char: "@", onPick: (item) => ... }`.
- `suggestions`: Not a prop. A trigger's `items` holds its suggestions.
- `trigger`: Not a prop. Ouro UI takes a list: `<Autocomplete triggers={[{ char: "@", label: "People", items }]}>`.

## Types

### `AutocompleteItem`

One suggestion in the list a trigger opens.

```ts
interface AutocompleteItem {
  /** Identifies the suggestion, such as a person's id. Unique within one list. */
  value: string;
  /** The suggestion's name, shown in the list and read by screen readers. */
  label: string;
  /** Quieter text at the end of the row, such as a role or the shortcode `:tada:`. */
  description?: string | undefined;
  /** Shows an `Avatar` for the label, with its picture when `src` is set and its initials otherwise: `avatar: { src }`. */
  avatar?: { src?: string | undefined; initials?: string | undefined } | undefined;
  /** A small picture before the label instead of an avatar, such as an emoji: `glyph: "🎉"`. */
  glyph?: ReactNode;
  /**
   * The text that replaces the trigger and what follows it when the suggestion is picked.
   * @default the trigger character, the label and a space: "@Avery Kim "
   */
  insert?: string | undefined;
}
```

### `AutocompleteTrigger`

A character that opens suggestions, such as `@` for people or `:` for emoji.

```ts
interface AutocompleteTrigger {
  /** The character, such as "@". It opens the list at the start of the text or after a space or an opening bracket. */
  char: string;
  /** Names the list for screen readers: "People", "Emoji". */
  label: string;
  /**
   * The suggestions: a list, which shows the items whose label, a word of it, or whose value
   * starts with what follows the character, or a function of that text (`query`, "" just
   * after the character) that filters and caps them itself. The list closes when none match.
   */
  items: readonly AutocompleteItem[] | ((query: string) => readonly AutocompleteItem[]);
  /** Called after a suggestion is inserted, with the suggestion and the query it replaced. */
  onPick?: ((item: AutocompleteItem, query: string) => void) | undefined;
  /** How many characters must follow the trigger before the list opens: a couple for emoji shortcodes, so a colon in a time stays quiet. @default 0 */
  minQueryLength?: number | undefined;
  /** Keeps the list open across spaces, for names with a first and last name. A line break still closes it. */
  allowSpaces?: boolean | undefined;
}
```
